answers.core: This is core functionality, an add-on couldn't address this
answers.workaround: Technically, yes; the situation I described is admittedly niche & a fixed-point system should ideally have plenty of designated and isolated classes/functions in its own right (hell, one [already exists](https://gitlab.com/snopek-games/sg-physics-2d)). But as far as working around the inherent truncation from ints to Vector2i/Rect2i/etc, absolutely not
